description: List the activity history for a single object, e.g. one file. Use object_type 'files' with a file ID to see what happened to that file.

limit.description: Maximum number of activities to return (default 50)

object_id.description: The object ID (e.g. the Nextcloud file ID)

object_type.description: The object type to filter by (default 'files')

name: get_object_activity
title: Get Object Activity
